subject.title: Allow owners and authors to delete messages

question: Should workspace owners be allowed to delete other authors’ messages only in workspace channels and threads, or also inside private DMs they do not participate in?
rationale: Current docs make DM membership and author-only deletion explicit, while the patch’s workspace-owner check applies to every message; only maintainers can define the intended destructive authority boundary.

options.title: Channel and thread moderation
options.body: Allow owners to delete other authors’ channel and thread messages while retaining author-only, participant-gated deletion for DMs.

options.title: Workspace-wide deletion
options.body: Allow owners to delete any workspace message, including private DMs, and explicitly document, test, and audit that elevated authority.

options.title: Keep author-only deletion
options.body: Reject the owner override and land only author self-delete controls and placeholder improvements.

recommendation.title: Channel and thread moderation
recommendation.body: Allow owners to delete other authors’ channel and thread messages while retaining author-only, participant-gated deletion for DMs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent web messaging ownership provides the strongest available routing signal for this cross-store authorization decision.
